title: PUT /tournaments/:id/rounds/:n/matches/:match/decision request
description: Settle a team match as a whole: forfeited to the first-named team (`forfeit_a`), to the other (`forfeit_b`), or a double forfeit (neither team turned up; refused once a game was played). Every board is rewritten and the previous results kept, so DELETE .../decision gives them back. A restore point is taken first, as at the desk. Answered with match-change-response.schema.json.
